title: Expose process and vector-store memory diagnostics
wanted_capability: A read-only MCP/admin surface that reports daemon RSS/anonymous/swap/referenced memory plus vector partition active/deleted counts and approximate heap footprint so operators can distinguish leaks from expected steady-state without scraping /proc and store files.
fallback_used: Read /proc/<pid>/status, /proc/<pid>/smaps_rollup, pmap, bbox_stats, bbox_embed_status, and vector store files manually.
notes: Observed prod blackboxd idle at ~11.7G RSS, ~11.6G anonymous, ~3.5G swap, with vector store persisted size 8.7G. /admin/runtime-metrics only exposes Tokio scheduler metrics.
